title: Kaeya's Gain
description: After much thinking, you finally solve the riddles contained within the intel you were given. The Lost Arcadian Ruins are now within reach!

mainQuestExcel.title: Kaeya's Gain
mainQuestExcel.description: After much thinking, you finally solve the riddles contained within the intel you were given. The Lost Arcadian Ruins are now within reach!

flow.stepDescription: Discuss your next step with Paimon

dialogs.text: This time, the mysteries have all been solved, it sure took a lot of work.
But in all fairness, this treasure map really is terrible... It looks like it was drawn by a pirate...
So now...
Let's report to Kaeya first.
Hmm? Paimon believes that there is no need!
You read my mind! Paimon's so happy!
Let's go for it! Don't want anyone else to get there before we do!
Like... like the Treasure Hoarders Kaeya told us about.
Anyways, Paimon just wants to borrow the sword to...
No, you heard nothing! Paimon ah— Paimon just wants to see it!
Definitely not to become super, mega, powerful and do nothing but play...
Hehe... Alright, Paimon'll save the chit-chat for later.
Arcadian treasure hunt, here we go!
Let's go to the treasure location directly!

flow.stepDescription: Use the map to find the buried treasure

dialogs.text: This must be the Arcadian Ruins.
Is it just me, or does it look... plain?
Oh, Paimon gets it! The perfect disguise is always in plain sight!
Kaeya's grandpa sure is impressive.
*pitter-patter*
Listen, Paimon...
Oh! Mice.
You didn't even try, did you?
It's no time to get suspicious. We're close!
Hurry! The treasure is waiting for us!

flow.stepDescription: Enter the depths of the ruin

dialogs.text: Ugh... Is this the end?
Where are you, my treasure!?
#Let's look around, {NICKNAME}.
Hahaha... I'll save you the trouble.
How about you let me take over?
The Treasure Hoarders?
Sharp eye, but too slow.
I'm Izzard.
I thank you both on behalf of the Treasure Hoarders.
Ugh...
We've been keeping a low profile, how did word get out?
Low... profile...?
Hmph! Paimon won't let you have the treasure without a fight!
You would be wise to not underestimate us.
My gang is just outside waiting for my order.
However, they're not as... sociable as me.
(Kaeya and the Knights of Favonius enter)
I'm sorry to rain on your parade...
But your gang won't be participating in your current plan.
If you'd like to ask why, you can go see them... in Mondstadt Prison.
Or perhaps you'd prefer to join them permanently?
The Knights...?
Hey, it's Kaeya!
Kaeya, he wants to steal your treasure! Get him!
Ugh... almost had it!
Oh, you mean the treasure?
Sorry, but there wasn't any treasure to begin with.
You came all the way... for nothing. Just give it up.
What?
No... treasure?
Did Kaeya just say, there isn't any treasure?
Hah. You got me good. Didn't think the Knights would resort to such tactics.
A thief has no right to criticize the methods of the Knights of Fav— Wait, what are you...
You're not gonna get me!
Okay... Oh god... Wh—What is this? I didn't mean it!
The black market?
Well, I did have dealings with them.
But them and their stupid principles... Losers who can't make a fortune.
How embarrassing... Having my life saved by a knight...
Don't forget what you promised... or that thing will be the least of your worries.
Hey... Is this how the Knights of Favonius treats the people they catch?
I'm just joking. Alright... Let's take him back.
Sir! Yes sir!
Captain, should we take these two in as well?
What!?
Haha, of course not. They are the ones who made this arrest possible.
So the intel is fake.
There is no treasure.
You lied to us?
Without them spreading our <color=#00E1FFFF>fabricated intel</color>, we wouldn't have been able to catch the Treasure Hoarders.
*cries* You're a bad man for lying to me... Shame on the Knights!
Alright, alright... Stop it already.
Though the treasure doesn't exist, you did want it for yourself, didn't you?
Otherwise, you would have informed me of your intentions, no?
That... well... ah... Hmph!
#Let's go, {NICKNAME}. Paimon's done talking to him!
Ha. Just a sec.
You did help me out, so you do deserve a reward.
This is the "Triumphant Harbinger of Dawn That Points Towards Victory." As its name suggests, it symbolizes light and victory.
If you don't mind, I would like to present you with this Harbinger of Dawn as a reward.
Harbinger of Dawn?
That's right. It suits a well-cultured and disciplined person such as yourself, wouldn't you say, Paimon?
Well... If the reward is this Harbinger of Dawn...
You'd forgive me, right?
I'm honored to have such an understanding friend.
Yes... yes...
...Paimon has been completely charmed.
Means you'll use a different method next time?
You have my apologies for the deception. I will not use the same method twice.
What a wonderful day. Now, I have to go interrogate my suspect...
Please excuse me. Do come visit me at our headquarters when you have the chance.

What a surprise that you solved the puzzles all by yourself and arrived before me.
So it was you who left all those clues?
Indeed. However, even I believed the clues were too vague to be of any help to you.
I was prepared to answer your questions...
Quite impressive. This was the only thing that I did not anticipate in the entire operation.
It was a cakewalk!
Uh, actually, I tapped into other sources for help...
Hah! That was nothing!
No matter what you say, I acknowledge your wisdom. After all, wisdom itself does not deceive.
But some people do enjoy deceiving others with their wits!
Hahaha...
What a wonderful day. Now, I have to go interrogate my suspect...
Please excuse me. Do come visit me at our headquarters when you have the chance.
